title: Custom PCR Setup from CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: Theis protocol is used to set up DNA samples for analysis with [Life Technologies QuantStudio™ 12K Flex Real-Time PCR System, OpenArray™ block, Accufill™ System](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4471090?SID=srch-srp-4471090#/4471090?SID=srch-srp-4471090). Using the [P20 Single-Channel Pipette (GEN2)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette), two PCR preps are accomplished. During the first prep, samples are reformatted and transferred from a 96-well plate to another 96-well plate before amplification. Once amplification is complete, the user returns the amplified plate and the second prep occurs - this time samples are transferred from the 96-well plate to a 384-well plate. Explanation of complex parameters below: * **Transfer CSV**: CSV file that contains the transfer information. It should contain the following header: SourcePos,SampleID,PreampPos,LoadPos1,LoadPos2 * **P20 Single Mount**: Select which mount the [P20 Single-Channel Pipette (GEN2)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) is attached to. *Note*: In the current configuration, up to 95 samples can be completed in one run. ---

steps.title: Load plates and verify Preamp mastermix
steps.instruction: Load the Source Plate and Preamp Plate onto the deck (if not already loaded) and confirm that the Preamp Mastermix tube in position A1 of the Tube Rack contains sufficient volume.

steps.title: Distribute Preamp Mastermix
steps.instruction: Using the P20 Single‑Channel pipette, pick up a tip, mix the Preamp Mastermix twice, aspirate 20 µL, and dispense 2.5 µL into each well listed in the PreampPos column of the Transfer CSV; repeat until all listed wells are filled, then return any remaining Mastermix to tube A1 and discard the tip.

steps.title: Transfer samples to Preamp wells
steps.instruction: For each row of the Transfer CSV, pick up a new tip, aspirate from the SourcePos well, mix three times, transfer 2.5 µL to the corresponding PreampPos well, mix three times, and discard the tip.

steps.title: Remove plate for amplification and load next plates
steps.instruction: After all transfers, remove the plate for off‑deck amplification. When ready for part two, load the amplified Preamp Plate and the Loading Plate (if not already loaded) and verify that the OpenArray Mastermix tube in position D6 of the Tube Rack contains sufficient volume.

steps.title: Distribute OpenArray Mastermix
steps.instruction: Using the P20, pick up a tip, mix the OpenArray Mastermix twice, aspirate 15 µL, and dispense 3.75 µL into each well listed in the LoadPos1 and LoadPos2 columns of the Transfer CSV; repeat until all listed wells are filled, then return any remaining Mastermix to tube D6 and discard the tip.

steps.title: Transfer amplified samples to OpenArray wells
steps.instruction: For each line of the Transfer CSV, pick up a new tip, go to the PreampPos well and mix three times, transfer 1.75 µL to the LoadPos1 well, mix three times, discard the tip; repeat the same process for the LoadPos2 well.

steps.title: Protocol complete
steps.instruction: When the robot finishes, note the on‑screen alert indicating that the protocol is complete and you may proceed to the next off‑deck step.
